backend/main.mo: Defines core actor types and state for users, providers, clients, jobs, documents, and MPesa config, and includes authorization and blob‑storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two logo‑related features, their linked components, affected files, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text index mapping many frontend file paths to short functional summaries for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light/dark mode using custom OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML scaffold that loads the React app entrypoint from /src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with routing, auth handling, and role‑based page rendering using React Query.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App layout wrapper providing header, footer, support drawer, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity hooks and handles auth flow including clearing cached queries.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Displays selectable user roles and submits the chosen role via mutation to set the user profile role.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing copyright, support trigger, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header showing the logo, role‑based navigation, support link, login button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Empty placeholder component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Shows animated platform statistics for clients and providers using backend data with minimum thresholds and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Displays a grid of hardcoded client testimonials with ratings and provider avatars.
frontend/src/components/landing/useLandi: Empty placeholder hook file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Provides inputs for address and coordinates plus a button to autofill location via browser geolocation.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Implements a basic messaging UI with mock send/refresh behavior and message rendering.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Handles M-Pesa payment flow simulation including phone validation, initiation, polling, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Renders a provider avatar with fallback initials and error handling for missing images.
Renders a static grid of featured provider cards using demo data with avatars, ratings, and basic info.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Displays a provider avatar with image or initials and supports multiple size variants.
Shows a provider’s summary card with avatar, rating, verification badge, and basic profile details.
Provides a dialog preview of a provider with avatar, verification status, ratings, and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Displays a card explaining and processing the connection fee required to unlock provider contact details.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Interactive star rating component allowing selection of 1–5 stars, with readonly mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Implements a drawer containing contact information for customer support via phone or email.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Hook that animates a count-up value when the attached element becomes visible in the viewport.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status states using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data such as user profiles, provider profiles, provider previews, and provider searches.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and component layers with custom color variables, dark mode theming, and landing page background styles.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service categories with icons and helpers to map business types to labels.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Admin page for reviewing providers, displaying status, and approving or rejecting verification requests with dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Renders a searchable grid of service categories and navigates to provider results when a category is selected.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Displays providers for a category with optional map view, falling back to an alert when Google Maps is not configured.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Shows the user's jobs with status, allows cancellation or completion with rating, and handles job state mutations.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Loads and displays provider details, verification status, ratings, and supports unlocking contact info and sending job requests.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Lists providers in a category with search, preview dialog, and navigation to detail or map views.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Implements the marketing landing page with hero section, login CTA, scroll-to-sections, and feature sections.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to view and edit their profile, upload a profile picture, and manage business details and location.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: React page for providers to view verification status and upload academic or conduct documents with progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Provides helpers to calculate a 10% connection fee and format KES amounts.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme colors, fonts, containers, animations, and extended utilities.
project_state.json: Project metadata outlining current app direction, architecture notes, known issues, and existing features.
